    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Board
    Interface defining the contract for a Tetris game board.
    Brick
    Core domain interface representing a Tetromino brick in the game.
    BrickGenerator
    Domain service interface for generating Tetromino bricks.
    BrickRotator
    Manages the rotation states of a Tetromino brick.
    ClearRow
    Immutable data transfer object representing the result of a line clear operation.
    ControlsPanel
    UI Panel for displaying and customizing game controls.
    CustomBrick
    Represents a custom user-defined Tetromino brick.
    CustomizePanel
    UI Panel for the Customisation Mode.
    DownData
    Immutable data transfer object representing the result of a downward movement.
    EventSource
    Enumeration representing the source of a game event.
    EventType
    Enumeration representing the different types of movement events in the Tetris game.
    GameController
    Controller class that manages the game logic and acts as an intermediary between the game board model and the GUI controller.
    GameOverPanel
    A modal screen displayed when the game ends.
    GameSettings
    Singleton class that manages global game settings and configuration.
    GameSettings.PieceSettings
    Data structure holding configuration for a specific Tetromino piece.
    GuiController
    The main controller for the JavaFX GUI.
    HighScoreManager
    Manages high scores for the Tetris game.
    HighScoreManager.HighScoreEntry
    Represents a single high score entry with player name and score.
    IBrick
    Represents the I-shaped Tetromino (4 blocks in a straight line).
    InputEventListener
    Interface defining the contract for handling game input events.
    JBrick
    Represents the J-shaped Tetromino (3 blocks in a row with one block on the right end).
    KeyBindings
    Manages keyboard bindings for game controls.
    LBrick
    Represents the L-shaped Tetromino (3 blocks in a row with one block on the left end).
    LevelSystem
    Manages the level and gravity system for Tetris following standard guidelines.
    Main
    Main entry point for the TetrisJFX application.
    MainMenuPanel
    Represents the main menu screen of the application.
    MatrixOperations
     
    MoveEvent
    Represents a movement event in the Tetris game.
    NameInputDialog
    A modal dialog panel that prompts the player to enter their name after achieving a high score.
    NextShapeInfo
    Immutable data transfer object containing information about the next rotation state.
    NotificationPanel
    A UI component responsible for displaying animated notifications to the player.
    OBrick
    Represents the O-shaped Tetromino (2x2 square).
    PauseMenuPanel
    A modal menu displayed when the game is paused.
    RandomBrickGenerator
    Core domain implementation of a 7-bag randomiser for generating Tetromino pieces.
    SBrick
    Represents the S-shaped Tetromino (zigzag pattern).
    Score
    Manages the player's score in the Tetris game.
    SettingsManager
    Singleton manager for game settings including audio, visual preferences, and gameplay options.
    SettingsPanel
    A JavaFX VBox that provides the user interface for modifying game settings.
    SimpleBoard
    Represents the game board logic for Tetris.
    SoundManager
    Manages all audio playback for the game.
    TBrick
    Represents the T-shaped Tetromino (3 blocks in a row with one block on top).
    ViewData
    Immutable data transfer object containing the current view state of the game.
    ZBrick
    Represents the Z-shaped Tetromino (inverse zigzag pattern).
